decision: 5 second time penalty 1 penalty point (total of 2 for the 12 month period).
event_name: Date 08 May 2022 Time 18:35 2022 MIAMI GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 May 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 3 preserved its position in front of Car 20 by leaving the track at turn 12 thereby gaining a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that although Car 3 was in front of Car 20 going into turn 12, it was only able to retain that position by leaving the track and returning to it alongside Car 20 then used its speed to pull ahead.
rules_referenced: Article 33.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 3 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
